headline.en: Give downloaded model files a checkable manifest.
headline.zh: 为下载的模型文件生成可检查的清单。

sub.en: hflock reads a YAML list of repositories, revisions and files, downloads those files, and writes a JSON manifest containing their hashes and sizes.
sub.zh: hflock 读取 YAML 中的仓库、版本和文件列表，下载文件，再生成包含哈希与大小的 JSON 清单。

body.en: Keep repository, revision and filenames in YAML.
body.zh: 把仓库、版本和文件名保存在 YAML 中。

body.en: Each download yields a SHA256 digest and byte count.
body.zh: 每次下载生成 SHA256 摘要与字节数。

body.en: The bundled HTTP fixture exercises the download and hashing path.
body.zh: 随仓 HTTP fixture 可运行下载与哈希计算链路。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The Python example serves examples/fixture on loopback, runs the real verify command and prints each generated hash. It stops the server and removes its temporary cache on exit.
note.zh: Python 示例在 loopback 提供 examples/fixture，运行真实 verify 命令并打印生成的哈希；退出时停止服务并删除自身临时缓存。

body.en: The Python example serves examples/fixture on loopback, runs the real verify command and prints each generated hash. It stops the server and removes its temporary cache on exit.
body.zh: Python 示例在 loopback 提供 examples/fixture，运行真实 verify 命令并打印生成的哈希；退出时停止服务并删除自身临时缓存。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/hflock.git
cd hflock
go build ./cmd/hflock

limitations.en: The demo hashes nine small metadata fixtures, not production weights. It performs no remote uploads.
limitations.zh: 示例计算九个小型元数据 fixture 的哈希，不是生产权重，也不进行远程上传。

limitations.en: init, sync and list are not implemented. Gitee AI and ModelScope mirroring remain roadmap items.
limitations.zh: init、sync 和 list 尚未实现；Gitee AI 与 ModelScope 镜像属于后续计划。

limitations.en: A newly computed digest records received bytes; it does not establish upstream authenticity or verify an expected digest. Use immutable revisions when reproducibility matters.
limitations.zh: 新计算的摘要记录收到的字节，不证明上游真实性，也不校验期望摘要。需要复现时应使用不可变版本。

body.en: A model download is hard to reproduce when the chosen revision and exact bytes are undocumented. Store the requested files in a lockfile and retain the generated hash manifest alongside your build.
body.zh: 如果没有记录版本和实际字节，模型下载很难复现。把需要的文件写入锁文件，再将哈希清单与构建一起保存。

body.en: The lockfile loader validates the request. The Hugging Face source resolves explicit filenames or globs and streams downloads through a SHA256 hasher into a local cache. The verifier writes repository, revision, path, size and digest to the manifest. It does not compare that digest with a trusted baseline.
body.zh: 锁文件加载器校验请求；Hugging Face 源解析文件名或 glob，将下载流同时写入本地缓存并计算 SHA256。验证器把仓库、版本、路径、大小和摘要写入清单；它不会自动将摘要与可信基线比较。

body.en: The lockfile loader validates the request. The Hugging Face source resolves explicit filenames or globs and streams downloads through a SHA256 hasher into a local cache. The verifier writes repository, revision, path, size and digest to the manifest. It does not compare that digest with a trusted baseline.
body.zh: 锁文件加载器校验请求；Hugging Face 源解析文件名或 glob，将下载流同时写入本地缓存并计算 SHA256。验证器把仓库、版本、路径、大小和摘要写入清单；它不会自动将摘要与可信基线比较。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --hf-base or HFLOCK_HF_BASE selects the HTTP source. --workdir or HFLOCK_WORKDIR selects the download cache. --manifest/-m selects the output file; --progress enables per-file progress. The example starts a loopback fixture server and uses a temporary cache.
body.zh: --hf-base 或 HFLOCK_HF_BASE 指定 HTTP 源；--workdir 或 HFLOCK_WORKDIR 指定下载缓存；--manifest/-m 指定输出文件；--progress 显示进度。示例启动 loopback fixture 服务并使用临时缓存。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run ./cmd/hflock verify examples/weights.lock.yaml --manifest weights.lock.manifest.json
# Use your own lockfile for actual downloads:
hflock verify weights.lock.yaml --progress
